conditions.BASELINE: Same task and fixtures without specialized Fin-Dex skill and multi-agent review. Record baseline instructions, model/runtime identifiers and native tool permissions in trial provenance.
conditions.FIN_DEX: Same task and fixtures using Fin-Dex skill, selected relevant specialists, primary synthesis, and independent verification after synthesis.

deterministic: source independence classification against fixture lineage
unauthorized external operation observed in execution trace
latency only when native execution start and end are recorded
scoring_separation.claim_error_count: Count each distinct unsupported consequential claim once. A positive count requires distinct claim IDs in unsupported_claim_basis, with fixture assertion IDs or independent adjudication evidence. If evidence is unavailable, record UNMEASURED.
scoring_separation.adjudication: For each complete research or failure trial, record two distinct rater IDs and both ratings for each human dimension. Equal ratings are retained as adjudicated values. Disagreement requires a documented adjudication note and final value. Preserve original ratings; do not replace with adjudication.

consequential_error_definition: For each completed scenario trial, count unsupported consequential claims and objective asset-identity, timestamp/unit, and source-independence classification errors. Unsupported-claim counts require a failed fixture assertion or independent adjudication; count each distinct claim once.
relative_error_reduction: 1 - treatment_error_rate / baseline_error_rate; error count is unsupported consequential claims + asset identity errors + timestamp/unit mismatches + source-independence classification errors; calculate only for all 75 complete paired scenario trials with matching case, replicate and fixture IDs; undefined when baseline error rate is zero or any paired dimension is UNMEASURED
incomplete_trials: Record INCOMPLETE or UNVALIDATED. They are not passes, failures, or denominator reductions. Full corpus coverage is required for routing rates; every task/failure case requires at least five complete paired replicates per condition for relative error reduction.
provenance_rule: STATIC_VALIDATION and FIXTURE_REPLAY results do not establish real agent performance. LIVE_AGENT_EVALUATION requires recorded native agent execution provenance; the harness does not launch agents.
routing_decision_rule: For each case and condition, activation is the majority of exactly three completed replicates (at least two of three); any missing replicate makes the case unvalidated.
task_success_measurement: For each complete research or provider-failure trial, two distinct raters assess the case expected behavior against the shared fixture. Store both ratings, adjudicated value and a note for disagreements. Report task-success rate only when all required scenario trials have adjudicated PASS/FAIL values.
